ecourier.auto_send: Send automatically when an invoice is marked as sent
ecourier.api_key_help: A pk_test_ key sends to the test network, pk_live_ to production.
ecourier.sender_address_note: The sender's name and address are taken from your company profile.
ecourier.tax_percent_help: Used only when an invoice carries no usable tax line.
ecourier.unit_code_help: UN/ECE Recommendation 20 code, for example C62 for a unit or piece. Left empty, no unit is sent unless the line has one.
ecourier.recipients_description: A customer needs a network identifier before an invoice can be addressed to them.
ecourier.scheme_help: A network identifier scheme, for example DK:CVR, GLN or DE:VAT.
ecourier.name: Legal name
ecourier.submissions_description: Every attempt to deliver an invoice to eCourier.
ecourier.resend_message: This invoice has already been sent through eCourier. Sending it again delivers a second copy to the recipient.
